settings.name: USE_REVERSE_PROXY
settings.description: **Enable Reverse Proxy:** Set to `yes` to enable reverse proxy functionality.

settings.name: REVERSE_PROXY_HOST
settings.description: **Backend Host:** Full URL of the proxied resource (proxy_pass).

settings.name: REVERSE_PROXY_URL
settings.description: **Location URL:** Path that will be proxied to the backend server. A value starting with `^` or ending with `$` is treated as a regex location. Optionally prefix with `~`, `~*`, `=` or `^~` followed by one space to set the nginx location modifier explicitly; no spaces, `;`, `{` or `}` are allowed elsewhere in the value.

settings.name: REVERSE_PROXY_BUFFERING
settings.description: **Response Buffering:** Enable or disable buffering of responses from proxied resource.

settings.name: REVERSE_PROXY_REQUEST_BUFFERING
settings.description: **Request Buffering:** Enable or disable buffering of requests to the proxied resource.

settings.name: REVERSE_PROXY_KEEPALIVE
settings.description: **Keep-Alive:** Enable or disable keepalive connections with the proxied resource.

settings.name: REVERSE_PROXY_HTTP_VERSION
settings.description: **HTTP Version:** Protocol version used to talk to the upstream (`1.0`, `1.1`, or `2`). Set to `2` for HTTP/2 multiplexing on the upstream leg. WebSocket locations stay on 1.1 regardless.

settings.name: REVERSE_PROXY_CUSTOM_HOST
settings.description: **Custom Host:** Override Host header sent to upstream server.

settings.name: REVERSE_PROXY_INTERCEPT_ERRORS
settings.description: **Intercept Errors:** Whether to intercept and rewrite error responses from the backend.

settings.name: REVERSE_PROXY_CONNECT_TIMEOUT
settings.description: **Connect Timeout:** Maximum time to establish a connection to the backend server.

settings.name: REVERSE_PROXY_READ_TIMEOUT
settings.description: **Read Timeout:** Maximum time between transmissions of two successive packets from the backend server.

settings.name: REVERSE_PROXY_SEND_TIMEOUT
settings.description: **Send Timeout:** Maximum time between transmissions of two successive packets to the backend server.

settings.name: PROXY_BUFFERS
settings.description: **Buffers:** Number and size of buffers for reading the response from the backend server.

settings.name: PROXY_BUFFER_SIZE
settings.description: **Buffer Size:** Size of the buffer for reading the first part of the response from the backend server.

settings.name: PROXY_BUSY_BUFFERS_SIZE
settings.description: **Busy Buffers Size:** Size of buffers that can be busy sending response to the client.

settings.name: REVERSE_PROXY_SSL_SNI
settings.description: **SSL SNI:** Enable or disable sending SNI (Server Name Indication) to upstream.

settings.name: REVERSE_PROXY_SSL_SNI_NAME
settings.description: **SSL SNI Name:** Sets the SNI hostname to send to upstream when SSL SNI is enabled.

settings.name: REVERSE_PROXY_SSL_VERIFY
settings.description: **SSL Verify:** Enable or disable verification of the upstream server's SSL certificate.

settings.name: REVERSE_PROXY_SSL_TRUSTED_CERTIFICATE_PRIORITY
settings.description: **Trusted Certificate Priority:** Source of the trusted CA: `file` (path) or `data` (base64/PEM).

settings.name: REVERSE_PROXY_SSL_TRUSTED_CERTIFICATE
settings.description: **SSL Trusted Certificate Path:** Path to a PEM CA bundle (readable by the scheduler) used to verify the upstream.

settings.name: REVERSE_PROXY_SSL_TRUSTED_CERTIFICATE_DATA
settings.description: **SSL Trusted Certificate Data:** Trusted CA supplied directly as base64 or PEM (e.g. via the web UI).

settings.name: REVERSE_PROXY_SSL_VERIFY_DEPTH
settings.description: **SSL Verify Depth:** Verification depth in the upstream server certificate chain.

settings.name: REVERSE_PROXY_SSL_CERT_PRIORITY
settings.description: **Client Certificate Priority:** Source of the client certificate and key, `file` or `data`.

settings.name: REVERSE_PROXY_SSL_CERT
settings.description: **Client Certificate Path:** PEM client certificate presented to the upstream for mutual TLS (priority `file`).

settings.name: REVERSE_PROXY_SSL_CERT_DATA
settings.description: **Client Certificate Data:** Client certificate as base64 or plaintext PEM (priority `data`).

settings.name: REVERSE_PROXY_SSL_KEY
settings.description: **Client Key Path:** PEM private key matching the client certificate (priority `file`). It must not be encrypted.

settings.name: REVERSE_PROXY_SSL_KEY_DATA
settings.description: **Client Key Data:** Client private key as base64 or plaintext PEM (priority `data`).

settings.name: REVERSE_PROXY_SSL_CRL
settings.description: **CRL Path:** PEM revocation list applied when verifying the upstream. Takes precedence over the CRL data setting.

settings.name: REVERSE_PROXY_SSL_CRL_DATA
settings.description: **CRL Data:** Revocation list as base64 or plaintext PEM. Used only when the CRL path is empty.

settings.name: REVERSE_PROXY_SSL_PROTOCOLS
settings.description: **Upstream SSL Protocols:** TLS versions offered to the upstream. Empty keeps the NGINX default.

settings.name: REVERSE_PROXY_SSL_CIPHERS
settings.description: **Upstream SSL Ciphers:** Cipher suite string offered to the upstream. Empty keeps the NGINX default.

settings.name: REVERSE_PROXY_WS
settings.description: **WebSocket Support:** Enable WebSocket protocol on the resource.

settings.name: REVERSE_PROXY_HEADERS
settings.description: **Custom Headers:** HTTP headers to send to backend separated with semicolons.

settings.name: REVERSE_PROXY_HIDE_HEADERS
settings.description: **Hide Headers:** HTTP headers to hide from clients when received from the backend.

settings.name: REVERSE_PROXY_HEADERS_CLIENT
settings.description: **Client Headers:** HTTP headers to send to client separated with semicolons.

settings.name: REVERSE_PROXY_UNDERSCORES_IN_HEADERS
settings.description: **Underscores in Headers:** Enable or disable the `underscores_in_headers` directive.

settings.name: REVERSE_PROXY_AUTH_REQUEST
settings.description: **Auth Request:** Enable authentication using an external provider.

settings.name: REVERSE_PROXY_AUTH_REQUEST_SIGNIN_URL
settings.description: **Sign-in URL:** Redirect clients to sign-in URL when authentication fails.

settings.name: REVERSE_PROXY_AUTH_REQUEST_SET
settings.description: **Auth Request Set:** Variables to set from the authentication provider.

settings.name: REVERSE_PROXY_INCLUDES
settings.description: **Additional Configurations:** Include additional configs in location block.

settings.name: REVERSE_PROXY_PASS_REQUEST_BODY
settings.description: **Pass Request Body:** Enable or disable passing the request body.

settings.name: REVERSE_PROXY_MODSECURITY
settings.description: **ModSecurity (per location):** Set to `no` to emit `modsecurity off;` in this location; bypasses the WAF on large-upload endpoints to avoid OOM (see note below).

settings.name: REVERSE_PROXY_MAX_CLIENT_SIZE
settings.description: **Maximum Body Size (per location):** Maximum body size for this location (`0` for infinite). When empty, the service `MAX_CLIENT_SIZE` applies.

settings.name: USE_PROXY_CACHE
settings.description: **Enable Caching:** Set to `yes` to enable caching of backend responses.

settings.name: PROXY_CACHE_PATH_LEVELS
settings.description: **Cache Path Levels:** How to structure the cache directory hierarchy.

settings.name: PROXY_CACHE_PATH_ZONE_SIZE
settings.description: **Cache Zone Size:** Size of the shared memory zone used for cache metadata.

settings.name: PROXY_CACHE_PATH_PARAMS
settings.description: **Cache Path Parameters:** Additional parameters for the cache path.

settings.name: PROXY_CACHE_METHODS
settings.description: **Cache Methods:** HTTP methods that can be cached.

settings.name: PROXY_CACHE_MIN_USES
settings.description: **Cache Min Uses:** Minimum number of requests before a response is cached.

settings.name: PROXY_CACHE_KEY
settings.description: **Cache Key:** The key used to uniquely identify a cached response.

settings.name: PROXY_CACHE_VALID
settings.description: **Cache Valid:** How long to cache specific response codes.

settings.name: PROXY_NO_CACHE
settings.description: **No Cache:** Conditions for not caching responses even if normally cacheable.

settings.name: PROXY_CACHE_BYPASS
settings.description: **Cache Bypass:** Conditions under which to bypass the cache.
